steps.en: A change from foreigner to resident status is received from the authorities
steps.id: Perubahan dari status warga asing ke penduduk diterima dari otoritas
steps.why_en: Only foreigner-to-resident changes are caught; the job is off live.
steps.why_id: Hanya perubahan dari warga asing ke penduduk yang tertangkap; job mati di live.

steps.en: A change of home address also pauses the notice
steps.id: Perubahan alamat rumah juga menjeda notice
steps.why_en: An address change alone never pauses a notice.
steps.why_id: Perubahan alamat saja tidak pernah menjeda notice.

steps.en: The details of the status change are saved on the notice
steps.id: Rincian perubahan status disimpan pada notice

steps.en: The notice is paused under a dedicated suspension code
steps.id: Notice dijeda dengan suspension code khusus
steps.why_en: Pause exists, but it expires automatically and a failure to pause is only logged.
steps.why_id: Jeda ada, tetapi berakhir otomatis dan kegagalan menjeda hanya dicatat di log.

steps.en: The notice stays at its current stage until an officer decides
steps.id: Notice tetap di tahap sekarang sampai petugas memutuskan
steps.why_en: Other jobs skip it, but an automatic revival date can release it without a decision.
steps.why_id: Job lain melewatinya, tetapi tanggal revival otomatis bisa melepasnya tanpa keputusan.

steps.en: The responsible officer is alerted to decide on the notice
steps.id: Petugas yang bertanggung jawab diberi tahu untuk memutuskan notice
steps.why_en: The alert is only a placeholder that writes a log line.
steps.why_id: Pemberitahuan hanya placeholder yang menulis satu baris log.
